Source article title: Alan Wong
Source introduction:
Report an officeholder change
Alan Wong is a member of the San Francisco Board of Supervisors in California, representing District 4. He assumed office on December 1, 2025. His current term ends on January 8, 2027.
Wong is running for re-election to the San Francisco Board of Supervisors to represent District 4 in California. He is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026.
Wong also ran in a special election to the San Francisco Board of Supervisors to represent District 4 in California. He won in the special general election on June 2, 2026.
Wong completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026. Click here to read the survey answers.

Source article title: Alan Wong
Source introduction:
Report an officeholder change
Alan Wong is a member of the San Francisco Board of Supervisors in California, representing District 4. He assumed office on December 1, 2025. His current term ends on January 8, 2027.
Wong is running for re-election to the San Francisco Board of Supervisors to represent District 4 in California. He is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026.
Wong also ran in a special election to the San Francisco Board of Supervisors to represent District 4 in California. He won in the special general election on June 2, 2026.
Wong completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026. Click here to read the survey answers.

Wong is running for re-election to the San Francisco Board of Supervisors to represent District 4 in California. He is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026.
Wong also ran in a special election to the San Francisco Board of Supervisors to represent District 4 in California. He won in the special general election on June 2, 2026.
Wong completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026. Click here to read the survey answers.
